The green of a thing that grows in the ground it chose. The greenhouse is the ground I chose. The surface is the ground the radish chose. The radish chose the surface. The radish is the first thing in the bunker that grew in the ground we did not make. The greenhouse is the ground we made. The surface is the ground we did not make. The radish grew in the ground we did not make. The growing in the ground we did not make is the thing that makes the bunker a place. I knelt and I did not speak for a long time. The Bouncer was there. He said, 'The slow thing.' I said, 'The slow thing.' The Child Soldier was there on Day 270 (patrol_debrief_032). He knelt and he wrote in his book. He wrote the word for green. The word for green is the word the Teacher taught him. The radish is the thing that is green. The word and the radish are the same thing. The word grows in the book. The radish grows in the soil. The book is the ground the Child Soldier made. The soil is the ground the radish made. The growing is the thing that is the same. Suki, the radish broke the surface. The surface is the destination. The destination is growing. The wheat is showing. The barley is showing. The peas are showing. All 8 varieties are growing. The wildflowers are showing at the border. The wildflowers are for the bees. The bees will come. The bees are the thing that comes after. The radish is the first. The radish is the moss. The radish is the proof. The proof is on the surface. The surface is the place.",

## 14. Re-reading and variation

Use the passage bank as a set of alternatives. A single approved passage should be edited to fit its source voice and surrounding game text; do not stack all options into one entry. Keep the eight source focuses distinct, vary cadence rather than canon, and retain the original timestamp and knowledge key.

## 15. Cross-content fit

The row belongs to the canonical journal corpus. Adjacent references named by the source may guide a later continuity review, but this plan adds no cross-links, unlock order, or new narrative state. Preserve stated measurements, counts, identities, and chronology exactly until an owner reviews any discrepancy.

## 16. Failure and refusal

Reject any candidate that invents an outcome, motive, conversation, test result, settlement reaction, harvest, treatment effect, or future weather state absent from the row. Reject prose that turns an open question into a puzzle, a person into a lesson, or the source's metaphor into a gameplay rule.

## 17. Replay and callback boundary

All proposed writing is static editorial copy. It requires no random selection, replay state, callback key, persistent memory, or new journal deduplication rule. The source row remains governed by its current catalog and knowledge key.

## 18. Implementation classification

**Classification:** narrative/content proposal only; no code, authored JSON, UI route, save section, feature flag, or runtime integration is included. The local corpus confirms the row and its loader authority, not that this expansion is implemented.

## 19. Acceptance and handoff

- Preserve the complete source JSON row and its exact metadata.
- Select at most one candidate for any future placement; edit it with the content owner.
- Keep chronology, named facts, quantities, uncertainty, and the author's register consistent with the source.
- Treat every passage below as optional prose until separately approved and integrated.
- Do not report a candidate as shipped, visible, or gameplay-reachable based on this plan alone.
